message: Pipeline started for duck-flight (issue #458). RunId: run-20260524T195018Z-6e28cd
Selected issue #458: Duck Flight — 3D first-person duck POV arcade game. Approved, not in-progress by another run.

Architecture: 3D first-person perspective projection, focalLen=300, vpY=286 (horizon above center). Rings travel from SPAWN_Z=3000 to KILL_Z=40 at 900 units/sec base speed. Duck.x range -1.6 to +1.6. Momentum mechanic: +0.12 on pass, -0.22 on miss, passive drain. Shell layout: position fixed top:64px bottom:56px. maxScore=500.

Generated index.html: full scaffold with 3D perspective projection, momentum system, ring approach mechanic, first-person duck POV, particle system, audio/anim stubs, difficulty scaler. No libraries. All systems named and modular.

Generated thumbnail.svg: first-person duck POV scene. Sky-to-ground gradient, perspective ground grid, 3 rings at varying depths with glow filter, particle burst near foreground ring, duck beak+wings silhouette, HUD overlay with score/momentum/misses.
Created meta.json: category=Games, leaderboard=true, maxScore=500, suggestion block for issue #458.
